cards.english_title: Israel Votes, but No Coalition Looks Secure
cards.korean_desc: 이스라엘은 2026년 10월 27일 총선을 열었다. 유권자는 120석 정당 명부에 투표한다. 여론조사는 야샤르가 앞서도 과반은 불확실하다고 본다.
cards.english_desc: Israel held parliamentary elections on October 27, 2026, after three years of war. Voters choose party lists, not individual lawmakers, for 120 Knesset seats. Polls show Eisenkot's Yashar leading, but neither bloc is assured of 61 seats.
cards.hook: Israel votes as neither bloc has a clear majority.
cards.takeaway_english: Election night may end the vote, but coalition bargaining will decide power.
cards.takeaway_korean: 투표는 끝나도 연정 협상이 권력을 결정한다.

why_it_matters.english: The result could change Israel's wartime leadership.
why_it_matters.korean: 결과가 전시 지도부를 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Coalition talks will decide who actually governs.

parties.label: Benjamin Netanyahu
parties.english: He seeks another term after wars, criticism, and corruption charges.

parties.label: Gadi Eisenkot
parties.english: His centrist Yashar party challenges Netanyahu on security and governance.

parties.label: Knesset
parties.english: A lawmaker needs support from at least 61 members to govern.

views.label: Netanyahu's supporters
views.english: They say his experience is needed during regional security threats.
views.korean: 지역 안보 위협에는 그의 경험이 필요하다고 말한다.

views.label: Opposition parties
views.english: They say Netanyahu failed to prevent the October 7 attack and manage the war.
views.korean: 네타냐후가 공격과 전쟁 대응에 실패했다고 말한다.

disagree.english: Neither camp is guaranteed enough seats, and the opposition remains divided.
disagree.korean: 어느 진영도 의석을 보장받지 못했고 야권은 분열돼 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 안보와 정부 책임 중 무엇이 더 중요할까요?

cards.english_title: Lula Wins, While Bolsonaro’s Party Accepts the Result
cards.korean_desc: 룰라가 10월 25일 브라질 결선에서 승리했다. 그는 경쟁자보다 약 440만 표를 더 얻었다. 10월 26일 자유당은 공식 결과를 인정했다.
cards.english_desc: Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's October 25 runoff. He won about 4.4 million more votes than his rival. On October 26, the Liberal Party recognised the official result.
cards.hook: Lula won; Bolsonaro’s party accepted the result.
cards.takeaway_english: Lula returns to office, but Brazil's political fight is far from settled.
cards.takeaway_korean: 룰라는 돌아왔지만 브라질의 정치 갈등은 끝나지 않았다.

why_it_matters.english: The split could shape Brazil's opposition after the election.
why_it_matters.korean: 분열이 선거 뒤 브라질 야권을 바꿀 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Markets fell sharply as investors worried about fiscal policy.
why_it_matters.korean: 재정 정책 우려로 시장이 크게 떨어졌다.

parties.label: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
parties.english: He won a fourth presidential term after trailing in the first round.
parties.korean: 1차 투표 열세를 뒤집고 네 번째 임기를 얻었다.

parties.label: Flávio Bolsonaro
parties.english: He questioned extended voting hours and continued challenging the result.
parties.korean: 투표 연장에 이의를 제기하고 결과에 계속 도전했다.

parties.label: Liberal Party
parties.english: It accepted the official result while asking for further debate about concerns.
parties.korean: 우려에 대한 논의를 요구하며 공식 결과를 인정했다.

views.label: Lula supporters
views.english: They say voter mobilisation defended democracy and produced a historic comeback.

views.label: Flávio Bolsonaro
views.english: He says extended voting was unacceptable and politically manipulated.
views.korean: 투표 연장이 부당한 정치적 조작이었다고 말한다.

disagree.english: Brazil's electoral court said the extension caused no changes to the result.
disagree.korean: 브라질 선거법원은 연장이 결과를 바꾸지 않았다고 말했다.

cards.english_title: Trump Moves Closer to Canada Before Midterms
cards.korean_desc: 마크 카니는 2026년 10월 26일 무역 협상이 조금 나아졌다고 말했다. 캐나다가 조건을 거절하자 미국은 50% 관세를 부과했다. 10월 23일 트럼프는 일부 관세를 풀었지만 최종 합의는 없었다.
cards.english_desc: Mark Carney said U.S.-Canada trade talks slightly intensified on October 26, 2026. The United States imposed 50% tariffs after Canada rejected earlier terms. On October 23, Trump lifted some tariffs, but no final deal existed.
cards.hook: Canada says Washington is moving toward its position.
cards.takeaway_english: The talks are warmer, but the tariff fight still has political and economic costs.
cards.takeaway_korean: 협상은 부드러워졌지만 관세 갈등의 비용은 남아 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Tariffs affect farmers, businesses, manufacturers, and shoppers.
why_it_matters.korean: 관세는 농민과 기업, 제조업체와 소비자에게 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The United States buys millions of barrels of Canadian oil daily.
why_it_matters.korean: 미국은 매일 캐나다산 석유 수백만 배럴을 산다.

parties.label: Mark Carney
parties.english: He says Canada's negotiating position has not changed.
parties.korean: 캐나다의 협상 입장은 변하지 않았다고 말한다.

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He lifted some tariffs while demanding better terms from Canada.
parties.korean: 일부 관세를 풀면서 캐나다에 더 나은 조건을 요구했다.

parties.label: U.S. Republicans
parties.english: Some candidates want tariff relief before closely watched midterm races.
parties.korean: 일부 후보는 중간선거 전에 관세 완화를 원한다.

views.label: Canadian government
views.english: Canada says progress depends on Washington accepting Canadian red lines.
views.korean: 진전은 미국이 캐나다의 금지선을 받아들이는 데 달렸다고 말한다.

views.label: Trump administration
views.english: Washington says tariffs can pressure Canada toward a broader agreement.
views.korean: 관세가 캐나다를 더 큰 합의로 압박할 수 있다고 본다.

disagree.english: Businesses and voters may see the tariff fight as costly and unpredictable.
disagree.korean: 기업과 유권자는 관세 갈등을 비싸고 불안정하게 볼 수 있다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 선거가 무역 협상에 영향을 줘야 할까요?

cards.english_title: A Narrow Truce Opens a Humanitarian Route in Oleshky
cards.korean_desc: 휴전은 구호품 전달과 주민 대피를 돕는다. 10월 27일 키이우 공격이 보고됐고 감시자는 정해지지 않았다.
cards.english_desc: The pause aims to bring aid and help civilians leave the city. On October 27, missile attacks were reported toward Kyiv, and monitors were not named.
cards.hook: A local truce began in Russian-occupied Oleshky.
cards.takeaway_english: The pause is limited, and its success depends on safe access to civilians.
cards.takeaway_korean: 휴전은 제한적이며 민간인 접근이 성공의 열쇠다.

why_it_matters.english: Remaining residents reportedly lack food, medicine, and safe passage.
why_it_matters.korean: 남은 주민들은 식량과 약, 안전한 통로가 부족하다.

why_it_matters.english: A local pause may create a route for evacuation and aid.
why_it_matters.korean: 지역 휴전이 대피와 구호 통로를 만들 수 있다.

parties.label: Residents of Oleshky
parties.english: They need food, medicine, and possible evacuation from the occupied city.
parties.korean: 점령 도시에서 식량과 약, 대피가 필요하다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: It says it is observing the ceasefire and preparing humanitarian assistance.
parties.korean: 휴전을 지키며 인도적 지원을 준비한다고 말한다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: It says its forces stopped fire in the Kherson sector.

views.label: Ukraine
views.english: The pause should permit aid deliveries, road clearance, and civilian evacuations.
views.korean: 휴전이 구호품 전달과 도로 정리, 민간인 대피를 허용해야 한다고 본다.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Russia says most residents wanting to leave already departed voluntarily.
views.korean: 떠나려던 주민 대부분은 자발적으로 떠났다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The truce's length, monitors, and humanitarian operation remain unclear.
disagree.korean: 휴전 기간과 감시자, 구호 작전은 아직 불분명하다.

cards.english_title: Israel’s Election Is Really a Coalition Puzzle
cards.korean_desc: 이스라엘은 2023년 10월 7일 공격 뒤 첫 총선을 열었다. 유권자는 전국 하나의 정당 명부에 투표한다. 정부 구성자는 의원 61명 이상의 지지가 필요하다.
cards.english_desc: Israel held its first general election since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack. Voters choose closed party lists across one national constituency. The leader chosen to form a government needs support from at least 61 lawmakers.
cards.hook: Israel votes, but coalition talks decide the government.
cards.takeaway_english: The biggest party may not be the party that forms Israel's next government.
cards.takeaway_korean: 최대 정당이 다음 정부를 만들지는 않을 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Israel has never had a single party win 61 seats.
why_it_matters.korean: 이스라엘에서 한 당이 61석을 얻은 적은 없다.

why_it_matters.english: Small parties can decide the next government.
why_it_matters.korean: 작은 정당들이 다음 정부를 결정할 수 있다.

parties.label: Likud
parties.english: Netanyahu's party leads the right-religious bloc.
parties.korean: 네타냐후의 리쿠드당은 우파 종교 진영을 이끈다.

parties.label: Yashar
parties.english: Eisenkot's party is expected to win many seats but lacks easy partners.
parties.korean: 아이젠코트의 당은 강하지만 쉬운 동맹이 부족하다.

parties.label: Arab parties
parties.english: Ra'am could become important if neither main bloc reaches 61 seats.
parties.korean: 라암은 어느 진영도 61석을 못 얻으면 중요해진다.

views.label: Netanyahu's bloc
views.english: A more ideologically coherent coalition may govern more easily.
views.korean: 이념적으로 더 단결된 연정이 통치하기 쉽다고 본다.

views.label: Opposition bloc
views.english: Replacing Netanyahu could improve governance and Israel's international relations.
views.korean: 네타냐후 교체가 통치와 국제관계를 개선할 수 있다고 본다.

disagree.english: The opposition includes leaders with competing prime ministerial ambitions.
disagree.korean: 야권 지도자들은 서로 총리직을 원할 수 있다.

cards.reader_question: Is winning the most seats enough to govern?

sentences.english: Israel held its first general election since the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack.
sentences.korean: 이스라엘은 2023년 10월 7일 공격 뒤 첫 총선을 열었다.

sentences.english: Voters choose closed party lists across one national constituency.
sentences.korean: 유권자는 전국 하나의 정당 명부에 투표한다.

sentences.korean: 정부 구성자는 의원 61명 이상의 지지가 필요하다.

cards.english_title: Britain Wants Permanent Residence to Be Earned
cards.korean_desc: 앤디 번햄은 2026년 10월 26일 영국의 정착권 원칙을 지지했다. 제안은 5년 경로를 바꾸고 소득과 위반을 본다. 최종 정책은 2026년 후반 예정이지만 시행일은 없다.
cards.english_desc: Andy Burnham backed earned settlement in Britain on October 26, 2026. A proposal would change the usual five-year route and judge income, violations, and contribution. The final policy is expected later in 2026, but no exact start date exists.
cards.hook: Britain backs earned settlement, but final rules are pending.
cards.korean_hook: 영국은 정착권을 벌게 하지만 최종안은 미정
cards.takeaway_english: The principle is clear, but migrants still await the rules that will define it.
cards.takeaway_korean: 원칙은 분명하지만 이민자들은 세부 규칙을 기다린다.

why_it_matters.english: People already living in Britain may face different settlement timelines.
why_it_matters.korean: 영국에 이미 사는 사람들의 정착 시한이 달라질 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Care services depend partly on overseas workers.
why_it_matters.korean: 돌봄 서비스는 해외 노동자에게 일부 의존한다.

parties.label: Andy Burnham
parties.english: He supports settlement being earned rather than automatic.
parties.korean: 자동이 아닌 노력으로 얻는 정착권을 지지한다.

parties.label: Indian migrants
parties.english: They may be strongly affected because Indians were the largest non-EU migrant group.
parties.korean: 인도인은 가장 큰 비EU 이주 집단이라 큰 영향을 받을 수 있다.

parties.label: Social care workers
parties.english: The government is considering whether to soften the proposed rules for them.
parties.korean: 정부는 이들에 대한 규칙 완화를 검토 중이다.

views.label: Government supporters
views.english: Longer settlement routes could make immigration more controlled and contribution-based.
views.korean: 긴 정착 경로가 이민을 더 관리하고 기여 중심으로 만들 수 있다고 본다.

views.label: Care-sector concerns
views.english: Stricter rules could make it harder to retain overseas care workers.
views.korean: 엄격한 규칙이 해외 돌봄 노동자 유지를 어렵게 할 수 있다.

disagree.english: The final policy, transitional rules, and exact start date have not been settled.
disagree.korean: 최종 정책과 과도 규칙, 시행일은 아직 정해지지 않았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 장기 거주를 소득과 일에 달리 정해야 할까요?
